img.caption: Fig 2: Main results across CLINC150 / MixATIS / MixSNIPS (unified protocol v1.0). Left: top-1 accuracy (Macro-F1 on CLINC150, Hit@1 on multi-intent); right: set-level Jaccard. Hatched bars with italic n/a mark settings not evaluated: CICC (split CP on BERT) was only run on single-intent CLINC150, and CLINC150 set-level Jaccard is not defined for single-label conformal baselines. On multi-intent benchmarks MULACONF hits high Hit@1 (0.73-0.97) only by emitting 150 intents on MixATIS; its set-level Jaccard collapses to 0.347. QP-OneModel 10-shot trails on both accuracy and Jaccard. Ours attains the best CLINC150 Macro-F1 (0.899) and the best MixSNIPS Jaccard (0.757) with tight sets of 1.5-1.8 intents, no task-specific training.
